topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Overview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture on the initiation and resolution of inflammation and frames how known immune mechanisms fit together.

topics.label: Innate Immune Recognition and Pattern Recognition Receptor Pathways
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how the innate immune system detects infection and cellular damage using conserved molecular patterns and diverse pattern recognition receptor signaling mechanisms.

topics.label: Acute Inflammatory Cascade, Leukocyte Recruitment, and Systemic Effects
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the cellular activation and recruitment events that drive the acute inflammatory response in tissues and its potential escalation into systemic pathology.

topics.label: Resolution of Inflammation, Tissue Repair, and Chronic Outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics address the mechanisms that terminate acute inflammation, coordinate tissue repair, and lead to chronic inflammation or granuloma formation when uncompleted.

topics.label: Lecture Closing
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture and previews the subject of the next session.
